Subject: Nimbus POC: Access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Priya / Alex / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have shared expectations for the POC: 

Summary of what Nimbus is trying to validate:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for clinical notes summarization and triage routing across two 3rd-party ingestion pipelines.
- Meet latency targets (99p latency < 450ms for 256-token requests) and verify inference cost/run-rate at projected volume.
- Confirm data controls (SSO access, IP allowlisting, token rotation, audit logs) meet Nimbus security requirements.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Accuracy: Summaries match current QA-set baseline in our eval harness (F1 >= 0.84 on the triage labels).
2) Latency: 99p < 450ms for 256 tokens on dedicated c5/gpu pool.
3) Throughput: sustain 30 reqs/s with <5% error rate for 1-hour sustained run.
4) Ops: SSO-based user access + IP allowlist in place; ability to rotate API keys without downtime.

POC scope & timeline:
- Access & setup (this week): SSO invites, temporary API key, IP allowlist for test subnets.
- Integration & baseline tests (wk of 7/26): one-week run of synthetic + small production-ish dataset.
- Eval & review (8/2): results, perf/cost recommendations, next steps for Dedicated plan.

Owners / asks from Nimbus:
- Confirm primary POC owner and technical contact for integration (we need their emails to send SSO invites).
- Provide SSO domain (Okta/Azure AD) or confirm if you prefer email invites.
- Share IP CIDRs to allowlist for testing (or let us know if we should use our test pool IPs).

What we (Redwood) will provide this week:
- Temporary scoped API key for POC.
- Instructions and a quick onboarding doc (attached: redwood-poc-onboarding.pdf).
- SSO invite and short runbook for rotating keys.

Next steps (action items):
- Priya / Alex: confirm POC owner emails and SSO domain + provide IP CIDRs if you have them.
- Marissa (me): coordinate with Technical Ops to create key and send invites once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
